name: Knaebe's Mmmunchy Krunchy Apple Farm
description: In Rogers City, MI, Knaebe's Mmmunchy Krunchy Apple Farm grows Apples, Pumpkins, and Corn on a family-run pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. The season runs through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
